acceptance: Reproduction recorded: the exact command (pytest with -p no:randomly, test_platform.py then the gizmosql tests, under make heavy-run) and the result of 5 runs in that order and 5 in the reverse order.
If it reproduces: the failing test id and the leaked state are named, the leak is fixed at its source, and both orders pass 5 times each.
If it does not reproduce in 5 runs of each order: the item is closed as not reproduced with the commands and output, and no code is changed.
context:
Decision gate: Reproduce first. Proceed to a fix only if the failure reproduces; otherwise close as not reproduced.

Item guardrails: Fix the leaking test or fixture, not the victim (no skips, retries, xfail or order pins); run test sets through make heavy-run.

Verification rubric: Pass = either a reproduced-and-fixed record or a not-reproduced record with commands and output. Fail = a change made without a reproduction.

Base guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight), never the primary clone; one PR per repository; no live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, servers) only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status; never start deliberate CPU, memory or disk load, and tests inject readings instead; comment policy (make comment-policy-check); changelog.d fragment for user-facing change. Re-verify every cited file and line on current develop before acting; they are hints and drift. Stop and report instead of widening scope; scope removed during review is re-homed to a named item or dropped by the owner with a reason.

Origin: Seen 2026-11-16 during PR #4276; the failing test id was not recorded.
description:
Problem: while delivering PR #4276 an agent saw one gizmosql test fail in the cli, mcp and system test sets only when tests/unit/cli/test_platform.py ran first; the PR did not touch that file. The exact test id was not recorded.

Outcome: the leaked state is identified and the test passes in any order.
